title: Mandatory Statistical Parameter Reporting in Micro-Stage Narratives
context: When generating micro-stage markdown (.md) and Word (.docx) deliverables from statistical JSON artifacts.
anti_pattern: Omitting explicit statistical parameters (t, F, beta, p, r, z, b, effect sizes) in the narrative text when they are present in the JSON artifact.
remedy_instruction: Always explicitly extract and report the primary test statistics from the JSON artifact in the narrative text using APA 7 format.
